problem.observed: The uploaded diagnostics for the bounded Taiwan official pull contained only the scheduler summary line, e.g. {"error":"ControllerTickError: scheduled source tick reported 1 failed connector(s)","stage":"schedule"}. The per-connector error was not recorded.
problem.cause: Connectors execute inside the source-ingest service. _run_tw_official_pull's finally block runs the egress restore (compose up source-ingest), which recreates that container, so its logs from the pull were gone before anyone could read them.
problem.consequence: Coordinators had to infer the cause from timing and reason codes; on 2026-10-08 one such inference was wrong and a policy task had to be withdrawn.

change: When the tick exits non-zero or times out, the harness saves those logs to diagnostics/tw-official-pull-source-ingest-logs.txt before the restore. Successful pulls run no extra command; failure messages, timeouts and the lease are unchanged.
test_changes: test_tw_official_pull_fails_on_scheduler_error_and_still_restores now expects four calls (up, tick, logs, restore) and checks the logs come before the restore; it previously asserted three calls.
